versions.changelog:
- Added documentation for customizing X/Twitter Push via push/preferences.md  
- Removed reference to push/user_profile.md in favor of new preferences.md for push module configuration  
- Updated setup instructions to clarify push module shares authentication/session with main pipeline  
- Improved guidance for real-time X highlights, including new OpenClaw cron job prompt  
- Updated and expanded user customization and documentation files

- Initial release of Multi-Source Feed (v1.0.0).
- Set up automated, AI-curated daily tech briefs from multiple customizable sources (Twitter/X, Hacker News, GitHub Trending, RSS, Reddit, Product Hunt, Tavily, and more).
- Supports deduplication, interest-based filtering, and structured memo delivery.
- Guided step-by-step setup: cloning, API key configuration, X/Twitter session capture, user profile customization, test run, and automated scheduling.
- User customization for interests, sources, and memo format via simple config files.
- Offers fallback for manual setup if automation fails.
